01 / Selected work

Complex systems.
Clear outcomes.

FROM REQUIREMENTS TO PRODUCTION
Deloitte · Application modernization

From mainframe interfaces
to cloud-native services.

Modernizing legacy COBOL applications for Java execution, with a Spring Boot integration service built from scratch and deployed on AWS ECS.

JavaSpring BootDb2 LUWSQSECS
Owned requirements, microservice development, and ECS deployment. Repointed mainframe Db2 interfaces to Db2 LUW pureScale, moved MQ integrations to SQS, and replaced legacy socket connections with REST endpoints. Built GitHub Actions pipelines for delivery.
A new path for legacy systems
Mainframe Db2→Db2 LUW
MQ→Amazon SQS
Legacy sockets→REST / ECS
INTEGRATE. MODERNIZE. DELIVER.
